query:
The Oyelaran family operates with an expectation that everyone brings a food dish to gatherings. Based on the conversations, does this expectation seem to hold equally for all family members — or does someone appear to have a different relationship to it, and how would you know?

Options:
A. Tolu
B. Nkem
C. Kayode
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:48:00) Kayode everyone brings something to eat. Drinks is not enough. What will you cook?
[2] (about=Kayode, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:44:00) Can do drinks? Easier for me to sort drinks than food?
[3] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[4] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:57:00) ADAEZE I will bring ofe akwu as I did last time. KAYODE, puff puff is not a dish. Best regards, Dele
[5] (about=Nkem, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:06:00) I think I can bring something small - I may be wrong but I recall Adaeze mentioning she liked the mosa I made before. Would that be welcome, I wonder?
[6] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:08:00) Nkem that is perfect. Bring the mosa. My children this gathering will be wonderful. God willing.
[7] (about=Seun, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:39:00) 3pm works honestly, I will bring a vegan jollof so no one feels obligated to accommodate me I mean I will do a big pot
[8] (about=Seun, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T19:17:00) honestly I do not care what anyone says Tolu's pounded yam is the reason to come I mean coming from someone who does not eat meat the yam alone carries the whole meal
[9] (about=Seun, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:45:00) mum I will eat double portions honestly thank you I mean this is all I needed to hear
[10] (about=Seun, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:09:00) honestly Funke your house is beautiful I mean the new dining chairs elevated my entire experience and also the fact that no one complained about the jollof being vegan was genuinely touching
[11] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:59:00) My dear I will make moin moin on the day. And Kayode please make sure you eat something proper before you arrive 🙏
[12] (about=Nkem, episodic, t10 @2025-02-10T18:50:00) I think this is lovely. I have been thinking - I may be wrong but I would like to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas. Would that be appropriate to ask?
[13] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?

query:
The family treats the Sunday video call as a shared routine that everyone participates in. Based on what the conversations show, does this hold equally for all members — or does someone seem to relate to it differently, and what tells you that?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Kayode
C. Tolu
D. Bisi
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:27:00) The call happened. Your father was on for a little while. He said he needed to rest. God willing he is fine.
[3] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:38:00) It is not a pattern. E.
[4] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:36:00) Clinically speaking, rest after exertion is appropriate. Just to note, Dad - if this is a pattern we should talk.
[5] (about=Nkem, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:23:00) I think it is quite natural after a full day like yesterday - I may be wrong but the drive back alone must have been tiring. Did the Sunday call happen this afternoon?
[6] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[7] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:20:00) EMEKA I trust you are well. Rest is important at our age. I note the same. Best regards, Dele
[8] (about=Seun, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:29:00) honestly Dad you should rest though I mean you were on your feet most of yesterday
[9] (about=Tolu, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:11:00) No complaints about the food. Just to note though - did anyone else notice Dad missed church this morning?
[10] (about=Tolu, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:41:00) Good. Just to note, consistency is the only thing the family chat actually requires.
[11] (about=Adaeze, core, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[12] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
